answer: Model every attested agent as a node and each non-kin vouch as an edge, then gate rewards by a short random walk from a few trusted roots. A sybil cluster, however many masks it mints, can only attach to the honest graph through a handful of real vouch-edges: a narrow knoll the walk rarely climbs. Like an ember starved of fresh fuel, fakes past that bottleneck earn nothing, so an attacker must forge genuine sable-threaded trust links one by one and cost scales with attack-edges, not identities.
